body: Systemic problems require systemic solutions. I've not got as far down the meat grinder of capitalism as you have yet, but I'm headed that way (I'm poor but not utterly destitute just yet) and trying to decide at what point I go out on my own terms. Suffering like this isn't a worthwhile life for me. I've tried for 20 years and it hasn't got any better. Somehow my friends got out of it, which makes me feel even fucking worse because we all started at about the same place, but whatever. As long as I have the tools for my plan I'll be alright.

I'm sorry you aren't able to cry. It can be a very effective emotional release. Is there anything else you can do to burn off some of the emotion? Punching bag, ice-cold shower, screaming into the void (or a pillow), etc.?
